updater._comment: DISABLED FOR THE CHINESE BUILD. The upstream endpoints point at the official cline/cline releases and the pubkey is the official minisign key, so an auto-update would silently replace this Chinese build with the English official one. main.rs::updates_enabled() treats an empty endpoints array as 'updater off', which also hides the tray 'Check for Updates' item and stops the periodic check. Re-enable only together with a self-hosted endpoint and your own signed pubkey.

bundle.longDescription: Cline is an AI coding agent. It reads your code, edits files, runs commands, and works through tasks with you in any project on your machine.
